question: What share of job postings are remote?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN remote_policy = 'remote' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS remote_postings_share FROM tech_job_market.jobmarket.jobs;

previous.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN remote_policy = 'remote' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS remote_postings_share FROM tech_job_market.jobmarket.jobs;
